title: bfo.db 0.3.0
text: Informative console messages. step now prints short cli explanation happening next (connecting, lazy vs. collected views, rows fetched, pool closed). Pass quiet = TRUE DatabaseConnector$new() silence . Safer connection cleanup. Added close() (alias disconnect()) close connection pool. Closing now idempotent — calling -op instead error — object correctly reports disconnected afterwards. pool also closed automatically garbage collection.

title: bfo.db 0.3.0
text: finalize() longer called directly; now private garbage-collection finalizer (recommended R6 >= 2.4.0). Use db$close() instead db$finalize().

title: bfo.db 0.3.0
text: AWS RDS CA bundles now ship inside package (inst/cert/), sslrootcert (ssl_key config.yml) optional. omitted, connection defaults global bundle (covers regions) falls back us-east-1 bundle. can still pass certificate path override. bundles public AWS certificates, secrets.
